updated_note: Edited by hand at the end of each stage; the page builder reads it.

stages.name: One split with a trained encoder
stages.question: Does the paper's single split work in our own code?
stages.result: Yes. Passes on all 5 seeds. The authors' own script also run: our numbers are close to theirs (about 0.01 lower on R²).

stages.name: Split a second time
stages.question: B1: does the second split work given correct pairs? B2: can those pairs be built from the data?
stages.result: B1: second split works with correct pairs (15 seeds). B2 (spec run, 18 runs): pairs built from clusters cost little (angle +1.3 deg vs B1) when clusters are right, but the world is too hard for the gates (B1 misses them too) and the split breaks below purity ~0.8.

stages.name: Deeper ladder and scaling
stages.question: How many levels hold up, and does error shrink with more data?

stages.name: Does it help?
stages.question: Does the ladder beat other methods at the same cost?

stages.name: Video-first handshake
stages.question: Can the pipeline find an unnamed conserved coordinate from pixels, certify it, and earn the name 'energy'?
stages.result: Certificate confirmed; naming 0.79 at 150 releases, 0.97-0.98 at 450 releases and 8000 steps (0.99 not reached). Hierarchical AR world: 1 cut, not 4 (E35 refuted). E36: split and control hold, closure gate weakly sensitive. F1: a release-free slow-feature direction finds the same coordinate. Live-footage test (E44-E47) blocked on the owner's recording.
